u0: Idle between clients: no order is pending. Watch for a client to arrive at the counter (go to u1 and take the order) and be ready to chase any food that slips (go to u5); otherwise continue waiting or reposition near the counter.
u1: A client is waiting and their order is not yet taken. Go to the client spot at the counter and toggle the client to take the order (go to u2); if the carried food slips first, recover it in u5.
u2: The order is taken but the agent has no food. Walk to the pantry, face it and pick up a portion (holding_food, go to u3); if that food later slips before preparation, recover it in u5.
u3: The order is taken and the agent carries raw food. Move to the stove, face it and toggle to prepare the food (food_prepared, go to u4); if the raw food slips first, pick it up via u5 and then return to the stove.
u4: The order is taken and the prepared food is in hand. Return to the waiting client, face them and toggle to serve (order_served, reward and back to u0); if the prepared food slips first, recover it in u5.
u5: The food has just fallen and the agent's hands are empty. On the very next move, step to the fallen food and pick it up (holding_food, go to u0), then resume the interrupted client cycle.
